title: Talk about travel
description: Practise travel phrases and say how you are going to travel.

items.targetText: I am going to take the train.

items.prompt: Say how you are going to travel next weekend.
items.promptIt: Di' come viaggerai il prossimo weekend.
items.exampleAnswer: I am going to take the train to Florence. The journey takes about two hours.
items.hint: Use going to and train or bus
